changelog: THE WARLORD HAS BEEN REDRAWN. His heraldry is now the army's own — a compass rose on the cap, at the throat, and on the medal bar — replacing insignia lifted wholesale from a real-world 20th-century army, which never belonged in a world that has no such faction anywhere in it. New art throughout: the commander card, the deploy plaque, and the store artwork all carry it. ALSO IN THIS BUILD, carried from 0.0.37: STEPS ON THE RUN-END SCREEN FINALLY COUNTS — it had reported 0 every run, win or lose, because the distance counter only ever ran on the enemy AI's move path and never on yours. Two things quietly rode on that same broken line and are now alive: the score's efficiency term, and the NEVER STOP MOVING medal, whose +2 defense had never once armed. THE ENEMY TURN NO LONGER LINGERS — every visible enemy action used to cost at least half a second because the code meant to compress a busy turn was clamped dead; one turn in four ran past 5 seconds, the worst past 20. The replay is budgeted now, and you can TAP TO SKIP the rest of it. END TURN CAN NO LONGER STRAND THE GAME, and a second tap during the "units can still act" prompt no longer ends the turn twice. THE BATTLE BOARD REFITS WHEN YOU RESIZE — it was fitted once when the battle opened, so maximising the desktop window left it sized for the smaller one. Your zoom survives the resize.
